name: claude-model-router
description: Model routing for Claude Code: delegate bulk reads and boilerplate generation to a cheap worker model, and measure what it saved.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Keeps Claude as the primary reasoning agent while shunting bulk file reading and predictable boilerplate generation to a cheap worker model. Hooks gate large reads, skills steer delegation, and every delegation is measured.

plugins.name: router-dashboard
plugins.description: Reads the model-router telemetry store and renders a self-contained HTML report: delegated tasks, tokens, worker cost, estimated savings, latency and routing quality.
